about: The stream POST /api/autoradio/programme answers for one request, as the L1 handler writes it (station L1 and slice C, the opening first; docs/design/autoradio-l1-failure-list-2026-11-15.md, test F44). The request is an extend with one title ahead, so the stream shows the new kinds: an opening, a transition that names the entry before it and the first title ahead (`ahead:1`, left for the phone to resolve against the titles it sent), then stories. A cause open is answered by one opening and done (tests C1 and C2 in the handler's package). The old kinds ident and bridge are accepted by the handler and renamed, and are not in this stream. The handler's own test runs the request with a provider that writes `model_lines` and compares what it streams, with the stretch id replaced by S. Hand-written text, no third-party text. A candidate's ref is pub:<route>@v<version>; a plain string cite arrives as {ref, role, label} (role defaults to subject, label to the candidate's title). A segment event carries no forecast: p_heard and caused_by are written to the tape and never sent. The `done` event is compared on the fields listed in done_fields only (the rest is timings and token counts). The model's lines are what a model writes; a line the handler drops is in the table under drops and is never streamed.

error_event: On a store failure, a run of three invalid lines or a failure after a segment, the stream ends with `event: error` and data {stretch_id, spoken, reason, status} instead of done; the segments already sent stand. The phone keeps what it has.
replay: The same request_id again returns the same stretch event and segment events from the stored records, then done with replayed true; a stretch that a restart interrupted returns its segments and then an error whose reason says so; the retry is a new request_id.
